decisions.reason: As a very recent launch that fits the firm's core push toward integrated automation, it is still an attractive option to keep open because uncertainty has not resolved and portfolio carrying costs are likely limited in project-based machinery sales.

Although the stand-alone de-shuttering robot may overlap somewhat with the combined system, it can still serve customers wanting partial automation, so management would likely keep it while market demand becomes clearer.

The profile storage robot looks more niche than the main production robots, but because it complements the automated plant portfolio and was only just introduced, the firm would likely wait for more evidence before abandoning it.

The stand-alone shuttering robot remains a plausible modular offering for customers not ready for a full combined solution, so the option value of keeping it on the market likely exceeds the near-term cost of doing so.
